---
title: "Economic Series Explorer"
description: "Compare economic time series from Yahoo Finance and FRED on one date axis, indexed or as actual values."
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {
  toRows, presetRange, PRESETS, effectiveStart, anchorAndIndex, colorFor,
  formatEndLabel, formatChange, yDomain, declutterValues, canSelect,
  PANELS, panelHeights, shownKinds, chartSubtitle,
  displayMode, DISPLAY_REASON, logScale, actualPoints, actualSubtitle, actualAxis,
  createLoader, isDaily, windowOverTenYears, downsampleWeekly,
  exportRows, toCsv, exportFileName, todayLocal, sourceCaption, exportLayout, EXPORT_TEXT, wrapText,
  parseFontFaces, pickFontFaces, fetchSeries, loadAll, failureMessage, descriptionNote,
  sliderBounds, dateToStep, stepToDate
} from "./js/series.js"

registry = (await fetch("data/series.json")).json()
registryIndex = new Map(registry.map((s, i) => [s.id, i]))
loadSeries = createLoader((id) => fetchSeries(id, fetch))
// isDaily per series id, computed once.
dailyById = new Map()
daily = (series) => {
  if (!dailyById.has(series.id)) dailyById.set(series.id, isDaily(series.dates));
  return dailyById.get(series.id);
}
pickable = registry
DEFAULT_SELECTION = ["sp500", "nasdaq"]
DEFAULT_PRESET = "10Y"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// A dropdown button over the grouped checkboxes; closes on an outside click
// or Escape.
viewof selected = {
  const form = html`<div class="series-dropdown"></div>`;
  const toggle = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary dropdown-toggle" aria-expanded="false"></button>`;
  const panel = html`<div class="picker" hidden></div>`;
  const open = (yes) => {
    panel.hidden = !yes;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(yes));
  };
  toggle.onclick = () => open(panel.hidden);
  const outside = (e) => { if (!form.contains(e.target)) open(false); };
  const escape = (e) => { if (e.key === "Escape") open(false); };
  document.addEventListener("click", outside);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", escape);
  invalidation.then(() => {
    document.removeEventListener("click", outside);
    document.removeEventListener("keydown", escape);
  });
  form.value = DEFAULT_SELECTION.filter((id) => pickable.some((s) => s.id === id));
  const boxes = new Map();
  const update = () => {
    for (const [id, box] of boxes) {
      box.checked = form.value.includes(id);
      box.disabled = !canSelect(form.value, id);
    }
    toggle.textContent = `Series (${form.value.length})`;
  };
  const emit = () => {
    update();
    form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  };
  for (const category of [...new Set(pickable.map((s) => s.category))]) {
    const group = html`<fieldset class="picker-group"><legend>${category}</legend></fieldset>`;
    for (const s of pickable.filter((s) => s.category === category)) {
      const box = html`<input type="checkbox" value=${s.id}>`;
      box.onchange = () => {
        form.value = box.checked
          ? registry.map((r) => r.id).filter((id) => id === s.id || form.value.includes(id))
          : form.value.filter((id) => id !== s.id);
        emit();
      };
      boxes.set(s.id, box);
      group.append(html`<label class="picker-item">${box} ${s.name}</label>`);
    }
    panel.append(group);
  }
  const clear = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Deselect All</button>`;
  clear.onclick = () => {
    form.value = [];
    emit();
  };
  panel.append(clear);
  form.append(toggle, panel);
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Presets plus a two-handle slider over every day in the registry. Dragging
// updates the dates shown; releasing a handle redraws the chart.
viewof range = {
  const { min, steps } = sliderBounds(registry);
  const form = html`<div class="range"><span class="control-label">Date range</span></div>`;
  const buttons = new Map();
  const bar = html`<div class="btn-group btn-group-sm" role="group"></div>`;
  const handle = (label) => html`<input type="range" min="0" max=${steps} step="1" aria-label=${label}>`;
  const lo = handle("From");
  const hi = handle("To");
  const dates = html`<span class="range-dates"></span>`;
  const show = () => {
    dates.textContent = `${stepToDate(+lo.value, min)} – ${stepToDate(+hi.value, min)}`;
    // Both handles at one end: the one that can move away goes on top.
    lo.style.zIndex = +lo.value > steps / 2 ? 3 : 1;
  };
  const set = (value) => {
    form.value = value;
    lo.value = dateToStep(value.from, min);
    hi.value = dateToStep(value.to, min);
    show();
    for (const [p, b] of buttons) b.classList.toggle("active", p === value.preset);
  };
  const emit = () => form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  for (const preset of Object.keys(PRESETS)) {
    const b = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary">${preset}</button>`;
    b.onclick = () => {
      set({ ...presetRange(preset, registry), preset });
      emit();
    };
    buttons.set(preset, b);
    bar.append(b);
  }
  // Handles can't cross.
  lo.oninput = () => {
    if (+lo.value > +hi.value) lo.value = hi.value;
    show();
  };
  hi.oninput = () => {
    if (+hi.value < +lo.value) hi.value = lo.value;
    show();
  };
  const released = () => {
    set({ from: stepToDate(+lo.value, min), to: stepToDate(+hi.value, min), preset: null });
    emit();
  };
  lo.onchange = released;
  hi.onchange = released;
  form.append(bar, html`<div class="dual-range">${lo}${hi}</div>`, dates);
  set({ ...presetRange(DEFAULT_PRESET, registry), preset: DEFAULT_PRESET });
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// A radio group as an OJS view. setState(disabled, reason, fallback) greys it
// out with the reason as tooltip and moves it back to `fallback`.
function radioView(name, legend, options, value) {
  const form = html`<fieldset class="radio-group"><legend>${legend}</legend></fieldset>`;
  form.value = value;
  const emit = () => form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }));
  const inputs = options.map(([v, label]) => {
    const input = html`<input type="radio" name=${name} value=${v}>`;
    input.checked = v === value;
    input.onchange = () => {
      form.value = v;
      emit();
    };
    form.append(html`<label class="radio-item">${input} ${label}</label>`);
    return input;
  });
  form.setState = (disabled, reason, fallback) => {
    for (const input of inputs) input.disabled = disabled;
    form.title = disabled ? reason : "";
    form.classList.toggle("disabled", disabled);
    if (disabled && form.value !== fallback) {
      form.value = fallback;
      for (const input of inputs) input.checked = input.value === fallback;
      emit();
    }
  };
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// PNG and CSV of what the chart shows; disabled when no chart is drawn.
{
  const png = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">PNG</button>`;
  const csv = html`<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">CSV</button>`;
  png.disabled = csv.disabled = !exported;
  const name = (ext) => exportFileName(
    exported.list.map((d) => d.series.id), exported.mode, exported.from, range.to, todayLocal(), ext
  );
  csv.onclick = () => {
    const text = toCsv(exportRows(exported.mode, exported.list));
    download(new Blob([text], { type: "text/csv" }), name("csv"));
  };
  png.onclick = async () => {
    png.disabled = true;
    try {
      const caption = sourceCaption(exported.list.map((d) => d.series.source));
      download(await chartPng(chart, caption), name("png"));
    } catch (error) {
      png.title = `PNG export failed: ${error.message}`;
    } finally {
      png.disabled = false;
    }
  };
  return html`<fieldset class="export-group"><legend>Export</legend>${png} ${csv}</fieldset>`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
utc = (date) => new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`)
selectedMeta = registry.filter((s) => selected.includes(s.id))
// Series that fail to load are named above the chart and otherwise treated
// as not drawn; the rest still plot.
loads = loadAll(selectedMeta.map((m) => m.id), loadSeries)
loaded = loads.series
failedNames = selectedMeta.filter((m) => loads.failed.includes(m.id)).map((m) => m.name)
mode = displayMode(displayChoice, selected.length)
win = effectiveStart(range.from, selectedMeta.filter((m) => !loads.failed.includes(m.id)))
indexed = loaded.map((series) => ({ series, result: anchorAndIndex(series, win.start, range.to) }))
shown = indexed.filter((d) => d.result)
kinds = shownKinds(shown.map((d) => d.series))
actual = mode === "actual" && loaded.length ? { series: loaded[0], points: actualPoints(loaded[0], range.from, range.to) } : null
logState = mode === "actual"
  ? logScale("actual", (actual?.points ?? []).map((p) => p.value))
  : logScale("indexed", shown.filter((d) => d.series.kind === "level").flatMap((d) => d.result.points.map((p) => p.plotted)), {
      levelsShown: kinds.includes("level")
    })
scaleType = logState.allowed ? scaleChoice : "linear"
// What the export buttons export: the drawn series at full resolution, or
// null when the chart shows a placeholder.
exported = {
  if (selected.length === 0 || range.from > range.to || loaded.length === 0) return null;
  if (mode === "actual") {
    return actual.points.length
      ? { mode, from: range.from, list: [{ series: actual.series, points: actual.points }] }
      : null;
  }
  if (win.start > range.to || shown.length === 0) return null;
  return { mode, from: win.start, list: shown.map(({ series, result }) => ({ series, points: result.points })) };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function chartContent() {
  if (selected.length === 0) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">Select at least one series</p>`;
  }
  if (range.from > range.to) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">The window ends before it starts on ${range.from}. Choose a later To date.</p>`;
  }
  // Nothing loaded: the failure message above stands alone.
  if (loaded.length === 0) return "";
  if (mode === "actual") return actualChart();
  if (win.start > range.to) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">${
      win.mover
        ? `The window ends before ${win.mover.name}'s data begins on ${win.mover.first_date}. Choose a later To date.`
        : `The window ends before it starts on ${win.start}. Choose a later To date.`
    }</p>`;
  }

  const leftOut = indexed.filter((d) => !d.result).map((d) => d.series.name);
  const note = leftOut.length
    ? html`<p class="chart-note">Left out (no data within 180 days of ${win.start}): ${leftOut.join(", ")}</p>`
    : "";
  const header = html`<div class="chart-header">
    <h2 class="chart-title">Indexed performance since ${win.start}</h2>
    <p class="chart-subtitle">${chartSubtitle(kinds, win.start, win.mover)}</p>
  </div>`;
  if (shown.length === 0) return html`${header}${note}`;

  const heights = panelHeights(kinds);
  const panels = PANELS.filter((p) => kinds.includes(p.kind)).map((panel, i, all) => {
    const rate = panel.kind === "rate";
    return drawPanel(
      shown.filter((d) => d.series.kind === panel.kind).map(({ series, result }) => ({ series, points: result.points })),
      {
        label: panel.label, reference: panel.reference,
        // Log applies to the levels panel only; rates stay linear.
        type: rate ? "linear" : scaleType,
        labelKind: panel.kind,
        tipName: rate ? "Change" : "Index",
        tipFormat: rate ? formatChange : (v) => v.toFixed(1),
        xDomain: [win.start, range.to],
        height: heights[panel.kind], showXAxis: i === all.length - 1
      }
    );
  });
  return html`${header}${panels}${note}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Actual-values mode: one series as stored, clipped to [From, To].
function actualChart() {
  const { series, points } = actual;
  if (points.length === 0) {
    return html`<p class="placeholder">No ${series.name} data between ${range.from} and ${range.to}.</p>`;
  }
  const header = html`<div class="chart-header">
    <h2 class="chart-title">${series.name}</h2>
    <p class="chart-subtitle">${actualSubtitle(series.unit, scaleType)}</p>
  </div>`;
  const chart = drawPanel([{ series, points }], {
    label: series.unit,
    ...actualAxis(series.kind, scaleType),
    type: scaleType,
    labelKind: "actual",
    tipName: null,
    xDomain: [range.from, range.to],
    height: 480, showXAxis: true
  });
  return html`${header}${chart}`;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// One chart panel. Panels share the width and left/right margins so dates
// line up; only the bottom one shows x ticks. `reference` null = no line.
function drawPanel(list, { label, reference, zeroFloor = false, type, labelKind, tipName, tipFormat, xDomain, height, showXAxis }) {
  const marginTop = 22;
  const marginBottom = showXAxis ? 30 : 8;
  const marginLeft = 56;
  const marginRight = 170;
  // Over ten years, daily series are drawn as weekly averages; the points
  // passed in are raw, so anchors and checks upstream use full resolution.
  const thin = windowOverTenYears(xDomain[0], xDomain[1]);
  list = list.map(({ series, points }) => ({
    series, points: thin && daily(series) ? downsampleWeekly(points) : points
  }));
  const rows = list.flatMap(({ series, points }) =>
    points.map((p) => ({
      id: series.id, name: series.name, day: p.weekly ? `Week to ${p.date}` : p.date,
      date: utc(p.date), value: p.value, plotted: p.plotted
    }))
  );
  const domain = yDomain(rows.map((r) => r.plotted), reference, { type, zeroFloor });
  const ends = list.map(({ series, points }) => {
    const last = points[points.length - 1];
    return {
      id: series.id, date: utc(last.date), plotted: last.plotted,
      label: formatEndLabel(series.name, last.plotted, labelKind)
    };
  });
  const labelY = declutterValues(ends.map((e) => e.plotted), domain, {
    top: marginTop, bottom: height - marginBottom, gap: 14, type
  });
  ends.forEach((e, i) => (e.labelY = labelY[i]));
  const ids = list.map(({ series }) => series.id);
  const channels = { Series: "name", Date: "day" };
  const format = { x: false, y: false, stroke: false, Value: (v) => String(v) };
  if (tipName) {
    channels[tipName] = "plotted";
    format[tipName] = tipFormat;
  }
  channels.Value = "value";

  return Plot.plot({
    width, height, marginTop, marginBottom, marginLeft, marginRight,
    x: { type: "utc", domain: xDomain.map(utc), label: null, axis: showXAxis ? "bottom" : null },
    y: { type, domain, nice: false, grid: true, label },
    color: { domain: ids, range: ids.map((id) => colorFor(registryIndex.get(id))) },
    marks: [
      reference === null ? null : Plot.ruleY([reference], { stroke: "currentColor", strokeOpacity: 0.4 }),
      Plot.lineY(rows, { x: "date", y: "plotted", z: "id", stroke: "id", strokeWidth: 1.5 }),
      Plot.text(ends, {
        x: "date", y: "labelY", text: "label", fill: "id",
        textAnchor: "start", dx: 6, clip: false
      }),
      Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointerX({ x: "date", y: "plotted", stroke: "id", channels, format }))
    ]
  });
}
```


```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function download(blob, name) {
  const a = document.createElement("a");
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  a.download = name;
  document.body.append(a);
  a.click();
  a.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href), 1000);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// The chart as one SVG — title, subtitle, every panel, note, caption — with
// its webfont inlined, rasterised at 2×. Resolves to a PNG blob.
async function chartPng(el, caption) {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const { pad } = EXPORT_TEXT;
  const panels = [...el.querySelectorAll("svg")].filter((s) => !s.parentElement.closest("svg"));
  const heights = panels.map((s) => +s.getAttribute("height"));
  const width = Math.max(...panels.map((s) => +s.getAttribute("width")));
  const titleEl = el.querySelector(".chart-title");
  const subtitleEl = el.querySelector(".chart-subtitle");
  const noteEl = el.querySelector(".chart-note");
  const W = width + 2 * pad;

  const titleStyle = getComputedStyle(titleEl);
  const family = titleStyle.fontFamily.split(",")[0].trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, "");
  const textWeight = Number(getComputedStyle(el).fontWeight);
  const titleWeight = Number(titleStyle.fontWeight);
  const fontCss = await inlineFonts(family, [textWeight, titleWeight]);

  // Wrap each text block to the chart width, measured in the page's font
  // (loaded on the page, so the canvas measures what the PNG draws).
  const ctx2d = document.createElement("canvas").getContext("2d");
  const wrap = (content, spec, weight = textWeight) => {
    ctx2d.font = `${weight} ${spec.size}px ${titleStyle.fontFamily}`;
    return wrapText(content, width, (t) => ctx2d.measureText(t).width);
  };
  const blocks = {
    title: wrap(titleEl.textContent.trim(), EXPORT_TEXT.title, titleWeight),
    subtitle: wrap(subtitleEl.textContent.trim(), EXPORT_TEXT.subtitle),
    note: noteEl ? wrap(noteEl.textContent.trim(), EXPORT_TEXT.note) : [],
    caption: wrap(caption, EXPORT_TEXT.caption)
  };
  const layout = exportLayout(heights, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(blocks).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.length])));
  const H = layout.height;

  const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
  svg.setAttribute("xmlns", NS);
  svg.setAttribute("width", W);
  svg.setAttribute("height", H);
  svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  svg.setAttribute("style", `color: ${getComputedStyle(el).color}`);
  const style = document.createElementNS(NS, "style");
  style.textContent = fontCss;
  svg.append(style);
  const bg = document.createElementNS(NS, "rect");
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({ width: W, height: H, fill: "white" })) bg.setAttribute(k, v);
  svg.append(bg);
  const text = (lines, y, spec, { weight = textWeight, fill = "currentColor" } = {}) => {
    const t = document.createElementNS(NS, "text");
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries({
      y, fill, "font-size": spec.size, "font-weight": weight, "font-family": titleStyle.fontFamily
    })) t.setAttribute(k, v);
    lines.forEach((line, i) => {
      const span = document.createElementNS(NS, "tspan");
      span.setAttribute("x", pad);
      if (i) span.setAttribute("dy", spec.line);
      span.textContent = line;
      t.append(span);
    });
    svg.append(t);
  };
  const muted = getComputedStyle(subtitleEl).color;
  text(blocks.title, layout.title, EXPORT_TEXT.title, { weight: titleWeight });
  text(blocks.subtitle, layout.subtitle, EXPORT_TEXT.subtitle, { fill: muted });
  panels.forEach((panel, i) => {
    const clone = panel.cloneNode(true);
    clone.querySelectorAll('[aria-label="tip"]').forEach((n) => n.remove());
    clone.setAttribute("x", pad);
    clone.setAttribute("y", layout.panels[i]);
    // Plot's stylesheet sets height: auto, which a nested SVG reads as 100%.
    clone.style.width = `${clone.getAttribute("width")}px`;
    clone.style.height = `${heights[i]}px`;
    svg.append(clone);
  });
  if (noteEl) text(blocks.note, layout.note, EXPORT_TEXT.note, { fill: muted });
  text(blocks.caption, layout.caption, EXPORT_TEXT.caption, { fill: muted });

  const img = new Image();
  img.src = `data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,${encodeURIComponent(new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg))}`;
  await img.decode();
  const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
  canvas.width = W * 2;
  canvas.height = H * 2;
  const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  ctx.scale(2, 2);
  ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, W, H);
  return new Promise((resolve) => canvas.toBlob(resolve, "image/png"));
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// @font-face rules for `family` with their files as data: URLs, read from
// the page's stylesheets. A cross-origin sheet (the theme's Google Fonts
// import) hides its rules, so its text is fetched. Offline → "".
async function inlineFonts(family, weights) {
  try {
    const sources = [];
    const visit = async (sheet) => {
      let rules;
      try {
        rules = sheet.cssRules;
      } catch {
        if (sheet.href) sources.push({ text: await (await fetch(sheet.href)).text(), base: sheet.href });
        return;
      }
      for (const rule of rules) {
        if (rule instanceof CSSImportRule && rule.styleSheet) await visit(rule.styleSheet);
        else if (rule instanceof CSSFontFaceRule) sources.push({ text: rule.cssText, base: sheet.href ?? document.baseURI });
      }
    };
    for (const sheet of document.styleSheets) await visit(sheet);
    const faces = sources.flatMap(({ text, base }) =>
      parseFontFaces(text).map((f) => ({ ...f, url: new URL(f.url, base).href }))
    );
    const rules = await Promise.all(pickFontFaces(faces, family, weights).map(async (f) => {
      const blob = await (await fetch(f.url)).blob();
      const data = await new Promise((resolve) => {
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
        reader.readAsDataURL(blob);
      });
      return `@font-face { font-family: "${f.family}"; font-style: normal; font-weight: ${f.weight}; src: url(${data}); }`;
    }));
    return rules.join("\n");
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
}
```

```{=html}
<style>
/* Full width: the explorer spans the whole screen, not Quarto's page column. */
main.content.column-page, #title-block-header { grid-column: screen-start-inset / screen-end-inset; }
.controls-bar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.controls-bar > * { margin: 0; }
.controls-bar .cell, .controls-bar .cell-output-display { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; overflow: visible; }
.controls-bar .cell-output-display:empty, .controls-bar .cell:has(.cell-output-display:empty) { display: none; }
```
